guardrails: Do not simply allow digits in outgoing questions
Do not include a unique suffix in placeholders
Keep original and decoded source unchanged for local Prompt Guard and harmful-content checks
Retain mappings and values only in the local AES vault
Arithmetic mean and average must still require averaging
A topic overlap alone cannot replace a missing compute or compare operation
Keep explicit table, grouping, percentage and rounding constraints
Require retained selection or applicable-value criterion
Do not make every question satisfy find
Disclose that the check remains lexical, not a semantic-equivalence certificate
Do not allow arbitrary capitalized words or proper names
Do not whitelist frozen item strings, public-title phrases or model outputs
Keep named values and unknown acronyms blocked
A real canary literal can never be passed through merely because the word is a category
Keep source-known values local and compare case-insensitively

notes: The prior frozen Stage6c run completed before these changes; no metrics from it are relabelled as corrected results.

Separate authored deterministic examples cover mixed source/candidate identifiers, semantic polysemy, lookup/writing aliases, finite opening functions, actual sentinel values and missing-domain-operation negatives.

The complete business JSON test uses the actual preparation, local Guard/injection hooks, checked guidance and AES-verified local-application functions with mocked model dependencies; no real send is possible.
Existing known literals and actual sentinel strings still fail the unredacted shape check or are neutralized before it. Unknown markers and arbitrary proper names remain blocked.
Identifier masking remains conservative, including mixed-letter/digit technical labels; intent checks remain lexical heuristics, not semantic certification.
